cases.job_description:
Senior Analytics Manager at Publicis Groupe ANZ
Responsibilities:
- Lead campaign and customer analytics programs across media and commercial teams.
- Translate analysis into executive recommendations and business cases.
Required:
- Must have SQL and stakeholder management expertise.
- Must have leadership and communication across executive stakeholders.
- Must have commercial analytics and strategic planning capability.
Preferred:
- Power BI
- Tableau
- Agency experience
